description: This EOB holds an elective knee surgery at an in-network hospital outpatient department by an out-of-network surgeon and anesthesiologist, both with signed consent forms, plus a ground ambulance ride. The anesthesia line is billed the difference as consented, though consent cannot waive protection for anesthesia; the surgeon's and the ambulance's differences are correct (decoys). The anesthesia line, a sound review concludes, owes in-network cost sharing only.
